title: Unbound site artifact reaches a gh-pages push
prerequisites: fork pull request workflow runs are not held for maintainer approval (repository/organization fork PR approval policy)
the attacker's fork run of build-site.yml is the most recent successful run when publish-site.yml runs
rationale: The downloader selects the latest successful Build site run on any branch with allow_forks, so a fork author can rewrite build-site.yml to upload arbitrary site content that the consumer pushes to gh-pages with contents: write.
